title: Mubeen AI: A Specialized Arabic Language Model for Heritage Preservation and User Intent Understanding
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the model's proficiency and cultural authenticity in Islamic heritage, including Quranic studies, Hadith, and Islamic jurisprudence. It also measured the model's adherence to religious and doctrinal guardrails, specifically testing its compliance with core Islamic creed, handling of jurisprudential disputes, and avoidance of impermissible content.
findings: Mubeen outperformed existing open-source Arabic LLMs with a 93.3% composite average on standard benchmarks, demonstrating particular strength in heritage-related questions (Islamic studies, Quran, Hadith). The model also achieved over 90% compliance in strict ethical and religious safety testing, successfully upholding Islamic doctrinal constants and appropriately managing jurisprudential boundaries.
